scope: Reviewed version-1 native TFR FP16/BF16-to-FP32 numerical source contract, support boundaries, independent deterministic fixtures and predeclared exact-bit comparisons. The 98 arithmetic fixtures and 20 matrix-memory layout fixtures were frozen before qualifying evaluation. Supplemental observations comprise direct native FEDP leaf RTL, separate host TfrFedp consumption, actual RISC-V API/consumer compilation, and source-root governance/tooling checks; those observations do not promote this A01 design-review record to whole-processor or WGMMA acceptance.
configuration: Tested source tree 7e459269e22f90691cf410e42068982f5a8c7a2d. Contract ci/project/p02_tensor_contract.json and docs/designs/tensor_numerics_v1.md, version p02-tfr-fp16-bf16-v1. Direct native leaf: RV64 context, T4, N=2 packed 32-bit words/four scalar products plus FP32 C, W=25, alignment=26, accumulator=30, latency=4, USE_DSP=0, LANE_MASK=1, valid mask 0x1111, FP16/BF16 49 cases each; no SV_DPI, fast-math or tracing. Separate application profile profiles/p02-tfr.json: one cluster/core, four warps of four threads, issue width one, native TFR/STD, ordinary dense WMMA; A row-major, B column-major, C/D row-major, zero initial C, KUNROLL=1, tile 8x4x8 elements. Twenty integer-exact source layouts cover 8x4x8 and 16x8x16 shapes. API matrix uses its separate fresh empty-profile RV64 build and 47 exact configurations; four kernel objects use freshly configured p02-tfr builds, with WGMMA overrides explicitly outside profile qualification. Exact generated configuration, tool/header identities, arguments and bounds are retained in the bundled formal manifests.
